task_summary: Populate an Excel workbook with two-way lookups, group statistics, and fold-change calculations on log2-transformed proteomics data while preserving formatting.
decomposition_rationale: The task is a focused openpyxl workflow on a single file with tightly coupled concerns (formula injection, formatting preservation, and proteomics-specific math). A single cohesive skill avoids artificial boundaries between these interdependent steps.

skills.name: evo-proteomics-excel-formulas
skills.description: Use when populating Excel workbooks for quantitative proteomics tasks: writing INDEX/MATCH lookups, AVERAGE/STDEV.S group statistics, and log2 fold-change formulas while preserving cell formatting via openpyxl 3.1.5.
skills.responsibility: Provide utilities to load/save .xlsx files preserving formulas and formatting, detect group/category cells by fill color, build sample/protein coordinate indices, and emit correctly-formatted Excel formulas (INDEX-MATCH, AVERAGE, _xlfn.STDEV.S, log2FC, 2^FC) for proteomics analysis.
dr_sections: 1. Workbook and Worksheet Loading with openpyxl 3.1.5
1.2 Accessing Sheets, Iterating Rows, and Reading Cells
2.2 Writing Specific Statistical and Lookup Formulas
4. Data Pipeline Patterns for Quantitative Proteomics
5.1 Arithmetic vs. Geometric Means on Log2 Data
